stories.title: Supreme Court says the end of SIR does not freeze voter lists
stories.summary: The Supreme Court said completing the special intensive revision does not mean electoral rolls are frozen. Names removed from draft rolls can still be restored, the court said, describing inclusion of voters as a continuing process rather than a one-time window that closes for good.

stories.title: Supreme Court says failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape
stories.summary: The Supreme Court held that consensual sexual acts cannot be recast as rape after a relationship ends. The bench flagged what it called a worrying trend of ended relationships being combed afterwards for something that could be treated as violence, and warned against weaponising criminal law.

stories.title: EC appeals against 16.10 lakh cleared Bengal voters face legal questions
stories.summary: The Election Commission filed appeals against more than 16 lakh West Bengal electors whose names judicial officers had cleared during the SIR. Questions are now being raised over whether the officials who filed those appeals had the authority to do so under the Act.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks EC report on Form 7 misuse in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: The Election Commission told the Supreme Court it found false Form 7 requests to delete voters during the Uttar Pradesh SIR, but said none were accepted. The court sought a report on the allegations and the corrective steps taken.

stories.title: Supreme Court asks Centre to curb misuse of live court feeds
stories.summary: The Supreme Court asked MeitY to frame measures against commercial exploitation of live-streamed hearings, which breaks earlier court orders. Watermarks and authenticated releases are among the ideas under consideration, according to the Solicitor General's submission recorded by the bench.

stories.title: 17 NC MLAs give party leadership a 15-day ultimatum
stories.summary: At least 17 National Conference legislators met for about four hours in Srinagar and gave Farooq Abdullah and Omar Abdullah 15 days to address their concerns. The list includes what they called unilateral decisions and a coterie culture, amid unhappiness over cabinet expansion.

stories.title: Jaishankar tells G20 ministers not to overlook the dangers of terror
stories.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar told the G20 foreign ministers' meeting that tactical calculations should not lead to overlooking terrorism. He called it a high-risk activity that has come back to bite even its practitioners, a line aimed at Pakistan.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi and Nirmala Sitharaman spar over IDBI Bank stake sale
stories.summary: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi and Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman traded barbs on social media over the government's plan to sell its stake in IDBI Bank. Gandhi backed the employees who are protesting the sale. It is their second public exchange in recent days.

stories.title: INDIA bloc postpones its 'public impeachment' of the CEC because of rain
stories.summary: The INDIA bloc moved its symbolic 'public impeachment' of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar from Friday to October 31 after rain in Delhi. The event is part of its campaign over the SIR and alleged vote theft, with a Ramlila Maidan rally planned for November 1.

stories.title: Amit Shah sets out BJP's Uttar Pradesh poll agenda
stories.summary: Addressing the BJP state executive in Lucknow, Amit Shah praised Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's law-and-order record and delivery of central schemes. He told workers to set aside doubts and focus on winning, amid talk of differences between the state and central leadership.

stories.title: UP's chief electoral officer holds district officers accountable for roll lapses
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa told district election officers to monitor electoral roll work daily. The instructions fix responsibility for delays, errors, unresolved complaints and supervisory lapses on the officers themselves.

stories.title: Rajasthan panchayat polls record 78.77% turnout
stories.summary: Voting for panch and sarpanch posts finished across 3,626 gram panchayats in 22 Rajasthan districts with a 78.77% turnout. The day also saw scattered violence, local disputes and a boycott in some places over delimitation.

stories.title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief
stories.summary: The Defence Ministry named Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia as the next Vice Chief of the Air Staff. He succeeds Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, who takes over as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on Saturday. Walia currently heads the Eastern Air Command.

stories.title: Congress accuses BJP of rationalising Chinese actions after Khandu remarks
stories.summary: Congress said BJP leaders were normalising Chinese transgressions on the Arunachal border after Chief Minister Pema Khandu said such incidents keep happening and are nothing new. Jairam Ramesh said the remarks contradicted Khandu's earlier dismissal of incursion reports.

stories.title: Press Club of India objects to journalist's name in Arunachal search warrant requests
stories.summary: The Press Club of India said it was shocked that Arunachal Pradesh Police included senior journalist Tongam Rina in search warrant requests linked to the October 23 violence in Pasighat. The PCI called it a serious attack on press freedom.

stories.title: Haryana BJP MLA questions party's merit-only jobs policy
stories.summary: Safidon MLA Ram Kumar Gautam said former Chief Minister Manohar Lal's policy of government jobs strictly on merit was wrong and had alienated workers whose children remain unemployed. He warned of anti-incumbency. The party defended the policy as corruption-free recruitment.

stories.title: Vice President says a prime minister from Tamil Nadu is possible
stories.summary: Vice President CP Radhakrishnan said a future prime minister from Tamil Nadu was possible, speaking after paying tribute at the Muthuramalinga Thevar memorial in Pasumpon near Madurai. Former Union minister Pon Radhakrishnan also attended.

stories.title: Akhilesh says Yogi prioritised Gorakhpur over Varanasi seats in MLC polls
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav accused Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath of securing the BJP's win in the Gorakhpur-Faizabad teachers' seat at the cost of two Varanasi-region council seats. 'Let Kashi drown, but our Gorakhpur business must not stop,' he said.

stories.title: Mirwaiz says Kashmir needs political engagement, not only security
stories.summary: Mirwaiz Umar Farooq said in his Friday sermon at Srinagar's Jama Masjid that the Kashmir issue cannot be handled through a security approach alone. He called for political engagement and efforts at reconciliation, saying this has been his consistent position.

stories.title: J&K minister asks LG to review highway closures for convoys
stories.summary: Health Minister Sakina Itoo wrote to Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha about closing both ends of the Srinagar-Qazigund highway during Army convoy movement. She said ambulances get stranded and people wait 15 to 30 minutes, sometimes hours, for convoys to pass.

stories.title: Seeman open to DMK and AIADMK support in Ambasamudram bypoll
stories.summary: NTK chief coordinator Seeman said he was open to accepting backing from the DMK and the AIADMK if they chose to support him in the Ambasamudram byelection, whenever it is held. He has already hinted he will contest the seat.

stories.title: Bhagwant Mann says Punjab gave 70,000 jobs on merit
stories.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann told a public gathering that his government has provided 70,000 jobs on merit, without bribes or recommendations. He said honesty in recruitment was helping ordinary families get government jobs.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu raises upper age limit for government recruitment by five years
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu raised the upper age limit for direct recruitment to government services by five years on orders from Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay. The official release said the change answers demands from candidates preparing for competitive exams. Concessions for some categories widen too.

stories.title: JPC hears experts on the socio-economic effects of simultaneous polls
stories.summary: The Joint Parliamentary Committee on the 2024 amendment Bills for synchronised elections met on October 30 to hear experts. They assessed fiscal costs, staffing needs and pressure on security resources from holding national, state and union territory polls together.

stories.title: Bombay High Court orders ₹2 lakh compensation for activist Arun Ferreira
stories.summary: The Nagpur bench held Arun Ferreira's 2011 arrest on charges of belonging to a Naxal group illegal and ordered the Maharashtra government to pay him ₹2 lakh. Ferreira is separately an accused in the 2018 Bhima Koregaon case and is out on bail.

stories.title: Karnataka declares the KPSC probe SIT a police station
stories.summary: The Karnataka government notified the High Court-constituted SIT probing alleged recruitment irregularities at the state public service commission as a police station under the BNSS. The High Court is set to name a new head for the team on Monday.

stories.title: Andhra police bind over 1.05 lakh people ahead of local polls
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh police bound over 1,05,767 people and executed 2,726 pending non-bailable warrants ahead of local body elections, DGP Harish Kumar Gupta said. Seizures include ₹4.91 lakh in cash, liquor worth ₹11.99 lakh and 495 kg of ganja.

stories.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA detained during drought relief protest
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Nitin Deshmukh and party workers were detained in Washim district while marching to the Samruddhi Expressway for a road blockade. Hundreds of workers and farmers had joined the protest demanding drought relief.

stories.title: World Bank data shows India's extreme poverty halved to 2.6% in 2023
stories.summary: Extreme poverty in India, measured at $3 a day in 2021 PPP terms, fell to 2.6% in 2023, World Bank data shows, down from 27.1% in 2011. The bank still calls wage disparity pronounced, with top earners far ahead of the median worker.

stories.title: Reliance Q2 profit jumps 41% to ₹25,548 crore
stories.summary: Reliance Industries posted a 41% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹25,548 crore for the September quarter, driven by oil-to-chemicals and Jio. Gross revenue rose 27.8% to ₹3,62,268 crore. Retail gains were more mixed.

stories.title: Census 2027 population count to start January 25
stories.summary: The Home Ministry notified the second phase of Census 2027. Self-enumeration opens on January 10, house-to-house population enumeration runs from January 25 to February 28, 2027, and a revisional round follows from March 1 to 5.

stories.title: Centre sets up high-level committee on banking reform
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry set up the High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat, chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N Patel. It will review the banking sector and recommend structural, institutional and regulatory reforms for competitiveness, inclusion and resilience by 2047.

stories.title: IOC profit nearly triples on refining margins
stories.summary: Indian Oil's standalone net profit rose 184% to ₹21,630 crore in the September quarter. The company credited better refining margins and a temporary dip in crude prices between mid-June and mid-August, and warned of volatility and possible inventory losses ahead.

stories.title: Jio Platforms profit rises 13% on subscribers and higher ARPU
stories.summary: Jio Platforms reported a 13% rise in net profit to ₹8,387 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations grew 11.3% and EBITDA rose 16.6% to ₹21,879 crore, with operating margins up 250 basis points on subscriber additions and higher revenue per user.

stories.title: Jio cuts net debt 79% to ₹8,822 crore
stories.summary: Jio Platforms' net debt fell 79% from a year earlier to ₹8,822 crore, its Q2 results show, with net leverage down to 0.10 times from 0.55. Total borrowings stood at ₹58,943 crore. The company credited EBITDA growth and lower capex intensity.

stories.title: Bank of Baroda posts its highest-ever quarterly profit
stories.summary: Bank of Baroda reported a record net profit of ₹6,532 crore for the September quarter as non-interest income nearly doubled to ₹6,881 crore. Net interest income rose 9% to ₹13,026 crore, and operating profit was also its highest ever at ₹11,430 crore.

stories.title: GAIL to list its city gas arm as Q2 profit more than doubles
stories.summary: GAIL's board approved listing city gas distribution arm GAIL Gas through an IPO, with the parent diluting a 25% stake. The state-run utility's consolidated profit more than doubled to ₹4,724 crore in the September quarter.

stories.title: Sun Pharma profit falls 36% on Organon and antitrust charges
stories.summary: Sun Pharma's consolidated net profit fell 36.4% to ₹1,988.5 crore in the September quarter after exceptional charges of ₹1,268.8 crore tied to its Organon acquisition and an antitrust settlement. Adjusted profit was ₹3,162 crore, revenue rose about 12%, and US sales slipped.

stories.title: IGL profit falls 93% as it absorbs higher gas costs
stories.summary: Indraprastha Gas reported a 93% drop in September-quarter net profit to ₹24.38 crore despite 8% higher sales volumes. Costlier input gas squeezed margins, and the company chose to shield consumers from global price swings, which it is now paying for.

stories.title: India cut US and Russian oil imports in September, turned to the UAE
stories.summary: India's oil imports from the US fell to zero in September and Russian supplies dropped sharply, official data shows, in the month the US Russia Sanctions Act became law. The UAE's share rose to more than a quarter of India's oil imports.

stories.title: Noel Tata pushes SP Group exit and restructuring proposals at Tata Sons
stories.summary: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata wants the Tata Sons board to take up the SP Group's ₹25,000 crore funding demand and a merger of two unlisted group companies with Tata Sons. The board meets on November 26, setting up a fresh boardroom contest.

stories.title: CEA says 2026 resembles 1991 and India should rethink growth strategy
stories.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran said geopolitical tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten India's access to critical resources. He called for stronger domestic capabilities in manufacturing, energy, agriculture and technology, diversified imports and strategic buffers.

stories.title: Centre's capex grows 12% in first half as subsidies widen fiscal deficit
stories.summary: Capital spending rose 12% in April to September and reached over 53% of budget estimates, Controller General of Accounts data shows. A sharp rise in subsidies, especially on urea, pushed the fiscal deficit up about 25%.

stories.title: Odisha lines up five semiconductor projects worth over $4 billion
stories.summary: Odisha has five semiconductor projects in the pipeline worth more than $4 billion, spanning chip fabrication and 3D packaging, alongside AI infrastructure investments. The state says it wants a full semiconductor and advanced electronics ecosystem.

stories.title: CCI clears Xavier Niel's 16.2% Vodafone stake deal
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India approved French billionaire Xavier Niel's acquisition of a 16.2% stake in Vodafone Group Plc through Vega SAS, a subsidiary of his family vehicle. Niel founded French telecom firm Iliad.

stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions gets CCI nod for ₹3,050 crore IntelliSmart deal
stories.summary: The CCI approved Adani Energy Solutions' purchase of all of IntelliSmart Infrastructure from NIIF and EESL. IntelliSmart is a smart metering company, and the ₹3,050 crore deal adds to Adani's metering business.

stories.title: Barrier-less tolling to cut the number of toll lanes on new highways
stories.summary: NHAI guidelines say the multi-lane free flow tolling system will reduce the lanes needed at toll gates on new and under-construction highways. Officials said that since vehicles no longer stop to pay, extra lanes are no longer needed.

stories.title: NHAI's local toll pass starts November 1
stories.summary: NHAI's concessional annual pass for non-commercial vehicles registered within 20 km of a toll plaza comes into effect on November 1. An official said it will improve compliance with barrier-less tolling and reduce e-notices.

stories.title: Imported medicines must now have a year of shelf life left
stories.summary: The Health Ministry ruled that imported drugs must have at least one year of shelf life remaining at import. Biological drugs and radiopharmaceuticals must have at least 60% of their labelled shelf life left instead.

stories.title: Credit card spending falls 5.9% in September
stories.summary: Credit card spending fell 5.9% year on year to ₹2.04 lakh crore in September, the first annual decline since February 2021. Online card spending dropped 12.5% to ₹1.26 lakh crore, which analysts link to festive shopping shifting into October this year.

stories.title: Infosys adds 10,000 seats with new Hyderabad block
stories.summary: Infosys opened a 1.1 million sq ft software development block at its 450-acre Pocharam campus in Hyderabad, adding 10,000 seats. Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka and IT Minister D Sridhar Babu inaugurated it with Infosys CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka.

stories.title: Omron Healthcare opens its first India factory near Chennai
stories.summary: Japan's Omron Healthcare opened its first Indian production plant at Gummidipoondi near Chennai, a 258,333 sq ft unit that will make blood pressure monitors for local sale and export. It comes three years after the company signed an MoU with Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: Bengaluru office rents grow as fast as Tokyo's
stories.summary: Bengaluru matched Tokyo with 11.5% annual growth in prime office rents in Q3 2026, according to Knight Frank. Delhi-NCR rose 5.4% and Mumbai 4%, with Bengaluru and NCR among the top ten markets globally.

stories.title: UPI now works for bookings at Burj Khalifa and Universal Studios Singapore
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry said Indian travellers can now pay with UPI for online bookings at major attractions including Burj Khalifa and Universal Studios Singapore. The partnerships were set up by NPCI International Payments, the international arm of NPCI.

stories.title: India's forex reserves fall $1.27 billion as gold slides
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $1.269 billion to $719.748 billion in the week ended October 23, RBI data shows. Most of the fall came from a drop in the value of gold holdings.

stories.title: CBI steps in after ₹22 crore goes missing at PNB Greater Noida branch
stories.summary: About ₹22 crore is reported missing from savings accounts and fixed deposits at a Punjab National Bank branch in Greater Noida. Victims include families who deposited Jewar airport land compensation. After 37 police complaints, the bank went to the CBI, which registered an FIR.

stories.title: October startup funding falls 51% to $694 million
stories.summary: Indian startups raised $694 million in October, down 51% on the year, according to the ETtech deals digest. Even Healthcare led with $50 million, followed by Different at $48 million and Boldfit at $41.5 million. Early-stage deals took 61.9% of the capital.

stories.title: MeitY proposes consent-based framework to share data for AI training
stories.summary: The IT ministry proposed a consent-based Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture for AI training. It aims to give startups, businesses and academic institutions access to large India-specific datasets to build AI models, while protecting citizens' privacy.

stories.title: Jio Platforms listing makes India the top IPO market in October
stories.summary: India raised a record ₹45,500 crore through IPOs in October, the most of any market, Bloomberg reported. Jio Platforms' ₹30,200 crore share sale made up much of it. That is more than twice the $2.1 billion raised in the US.

stories.title: Sachin Bansal keeps 84.34% of Navi after ₹940 crore Prosus round
stories.summary: Filings show Navi issued preference shares worth about ₹940 crore in a round led by Prosus, valuing the fintech at ₹13,192 crore. Founder Sachin Bansal remains the largest shareholder with an 84.34% stake, which is most of the company.

stories.title: PB Fintech profit rises 43% to ₹192 crore
stories.summary: PB Fintech, parent of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, reported a 43% rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹192 crore. Revenue from operations grew 35% to ₹2,178 crore, with insurance broking contributing ₹2,015 crore, up 41% from a year earlier.

stories.title: Policybazaar says Irdai draft rules may force a rethink of its agent business
stories.summary: PB Fintech CEO Yashish Dahiya said its point-of-sale insurance distribution business may need restructuring if the regulator's proposed rules are adopted as drafted. The company will wait for final rules, and said the business could evolve into a services player.

stories.title: Delhivery reports ₹41 crore profit as revenue grows 19.8%
stories.summary: Delhivery's revenue from operations rose 19.8% to ₹3,066 crore in Q2 FY27, from ₹2,559 crore a year earlier, and the logistics company stayed profitable with a ₹41 crore profit. Freight, handling and servicing remained its largest cost, at about 71% of expenses.

stories.title: Atomberg gets SEBI nod for IPO
stories.summary: Consumer appliance maker Atomberg Technologies received SEBI approval for an IPO combining a fresh issue and an offer for sale. It plans to raise ₹450 crore through fresh shares and use the money for debt repayment, branding and marketing, and R&D.

stories.title: Ratnadeep Retail gets SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Hyderabad grocery and value fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail received SEBI approval for an IPO with a ₹400 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale of up to 1.49 crore shares. Proceeds will repay debt and fund new stores.

stories.title: Flipkart kickback probe raises questions over vendor oversight
stories.summary: Flipkart is investigating nearly 150 employees over alleged kickbacks from vendors in its smartphone and luggage categories. The probe puts its internal controls and governance under scrutiny as the company prepares for a possible public listing.

stories.title: Labour ministry sets up social security board for gig workers
stories.summary: The Labour Ministry notified the National Social Security Board for Unorganised Workers and Gig and Platform Workers under the 2020 Code on Social Security. The labour minister will chair it, with representatives from central and state governments.

stories.title: Manastu Space raises ₹22 crore in an extended round
stories.summary: Spacetech startup Manastu Space raised ₹22 crore from Gandhi Securities, the Thacker Legacy Trusts and angels in what appears to extend its Series A, Inc42 reported. It follows ₹116 crore from the Technology Development Board in optionally convertible debentures.

stories.title: Smartworks swings to ₹26 crore quarterly profit
stories.summary: Managed workspace provider Smartworks posted a consolidated net profit of ₹25.6 crore in Q2 FY27 against a ₹3.1 crore loss a year earlier. Operating revenue rose 39.2% to ₹591.4 crore.

stories.title: Traya nears ₹600 crore revenue but stays loss-making
stories.summary: Haircare startup Traya's revenue from operations rose 72.6% to ₹585 crore in FY26 from ₹339 crore, Entrackr reports. The seven-year-old company, which sells customised hair loss kits backed by coaches and doctors, still reported a loss of about ₹29 crore.

stories.title: Tata Starbucks revenue rises 7% to ₹1,367 crore, losses narrow
stories.summary: Tata Starbucks, the 50:50 joint venture of Tata Consumer Products and Starbucks, grew FY26 revenue from operations 7% to ₹1,367 crore and cut its losses by 27%. It is one of India's largest coffee chains, and still in the red.

stories.title: Carrum built a ₹233 crore business running cars for Uber
stories.summary: Gurugram-based Carrum Mobility, founded in 2024 by Revv co-founder Karan Jain, runs a profitable fleet business largely around Uber. The open question is whether it can grow beyond its biggest customer.

stories.title: Nasscom asks to defer new GST rules for ecommerce deliveries
stories.summary: Nasscom asked the finance ministry to push revised GST rules for ecommerce delivery services to January 2027. Its October 28 representation said marketplaces need time to overhaul technology, accounting and compliance systems.

stories.title: Cat food startup Smylo in talks to raise ₹30 crore
stories.summary: D2C cat food startup Smylo is in advanced talks to raise about ₹30 crore in equity and debt, Inc42 reported, citing sources. A new venture capital firm is likely to join, and existing backer DSG Consumer Partners may invest further.

stories.title: Protein Pantry raises ₹9 crore for frozen food
stories.summary: High-protein vegetarian frozen food brand Protein Pantry raised ₹9 crore in a seed round led by Sharrp Ventures. It plans to expand manufacturing, strengthen its supply chain and widen distribution across India.

stories.title: Tensrai raises ₹3.4 crore to make existing machines autonomous
stories.summary: Hyderabad physical AI startup Tensrai raised ₹3.4 crore in pre-seed funding from India Accelerator, Finvolve and Hyderabad Angels. It builds software that lets existing robots, vehicles and machines perform physical tasks on their own.

stories.title: Qiroko raises ₹1.5 crore to expand into watches and bags
stories.summary: Bengaluru fashion accessories brand Qiroko raised ₹1.5 crore in a pre-seed round led by ISV Capital. It will use the money for new products, expansion into watches and bags, and wider distribution across its website, marketplaces and quick commerce.

stories.title: Delhi records its coldest October day since 1951
stories.summary: Delhi's maximum temperature at Safdarjung plunged on October 30, making it the coldest October day since 1951. The city also logged its cleanest October air in over a decade, with an average AQI of 167, the lowest for the month since 2015.

stories.title: Construction and demolition halted in Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20
stories.summary: The Centre paused construction and demolition across Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20 to curb air pollution. Delhi's air quality is expected to slip into the poor category from November 1, which is when the pause starts to look sensible.

stories.title: Half of office staff to work from home under Delhi-NCR November pollution plan
stories.summary: Offices in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar will cap attendance at 50% in November as part of the pollution plan. Industrial units and essential services where remote work is not feasible are exempt.

stories.title: Rain cleans Delhi's air for only about five days, study finds
stories.summary: A study of 612 rainfall events in Delhi between 2003 and 2024 found that pollution particles return to pre-rain levels within about five days. The authors say this shows the need for sustained cuts in emissions rather than hoping for showers.

stories.title: Two arrested over Kuno cheetah cub killing
stories.summary: Two people were arrested by a special task force under the Arms Act over the killing of a male cheetah cub at Kuno National Park, officials said. Investigators are still searching for the country-made muzzle-loading gun believed to have been used.

stories.title: Electrocution caused 32 of 49 elephant deaths in Chittoor since 2015
stories.summary: Chittoor Collector Sumit Kumar asked the Forest Department and the southern power distribution company to act together after reviewing data showing electrocution behind most elephant deaths in the region since 2015. He ordered 150 critical power line spots fixed.

stories.title: ENGIE commissions 450 MW of solar in Rajasthan and Gujarat
stories.summary: ENGIE fully commissioned its 250 MW Khaba solar project in Rajasthan and its 200 MW Khavda project in Gujarat, adding 450 MW of operating capacity in India. The Khavda plant supplies GUVNL under a 25-year power purchase agreement.

stories.title: Waaree starts 1.6 GW of solar module lines in Texas
stories.summary: Waaree Energies' US subsidiary began commercial production on two new solar module lines in Texas with a combined annual capacity of 1.6 GW, at 800 MW each, adding to its American manufacturing base.

stories.title: Suzlon revenue rises 26% on higher deliveries
stories.summary: Wind turbine maker Suzlon Energy reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹4,869 crore, up 26% from ₹3,866 crore a year earlier, on higher turbine deliveries. Profit for the quarter was ₹394 crore.

stories.title: NTPC Green Energy profit rises 59% to ₹137.5 crore
stories.summary: NTPC Green Energy posted a 59% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹137.50 crore for the September quarter. Total income rose 52% to ₹1,000.76 crore from ₹656.72 crore a year earlier.

stories.title: JSW Energy profit rises 38% as capacity crosses 15 GW
stories.summary: JSW Energy's Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose about 23% to ₹6,368.47 crore and consolidated profit after tax climbed 38% to ₹1,141.04 crore. Quarterly EBITDA hit a record ₹3,907 crore and total installed capacity crossed 15 GW.

stories.title: Telangana regulator approves buying 2,545 MW of solar power
stories.summary: The Telangana Electricity Regulatory Commission approved state discoms buying 2,545 MW of solar power from NTPC, NHPC and SECI. It told the discoms not to pass developer-related transmission costs on to consumers.

stories.title: Solar cell capacity on the approved list grows to 45 GW
stories.summary: MNRE added 7,063 MW of solar cell manufacturing capacity to the ALMM List-II, taking the total enlisted capacity to about 45 GW. The list decides which domestic cells qualify for government-backed projects.

stories.title: Kerala regulator rejects costly peak power purchases and flags battery delays
stories.summary: The Kerala State Electricity Regulatory Commission only partly approved KSEB's short-term power purchase plan, rejecting expensive peak-hour buys for March and April 2027. It also flagged delays in battery energy storage projects.

stories.title: NTPC gets nod for India's first ceramic-storage solar pilot at Bhadla
stories.summary: Rajasthan's renewable energy agency approved a 320 kW concentrated solar power pilot by NTPC at Bhadla Solar Park. Daytime solar heat is stored in high-temperature ceramic modules and later drives an air turbine after sunset, cutting reliance on batteries.

stories.title: Gadkari says ₹22 per unit EV charging is too high
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari said EV charging at ₹22 per unit is too expensive and suggested Maharashtra consider a ₹5 per unit daytime tariff. He spoke at the opening of EKA Mobility's manufacturing facilities in Pune.

stories.title: Microtek to invest over ₹400 crore in solar
stories.summary: Power backup maker Microtek plans to invest more than ₹400 crore to expand its solar energy business, including manufacturing capacity and new solar products, EQ reported. The move diversifies it beyond inverters and batteries toward residential, commercial and industrial solar demand.

stories.title: India's green finance flows reach $82 billion
stories.summary: India's green finance flows rose to $81.9 billion in 2023-24 from $50 billion in 2021-22, according to a report cited by EQ. Most money still goes to established areas like clean energy and efficiency, leaving adaptation and newer sectors short of funding.

stories.title: USDA says drought will slow India's milk output growth to 2%
stories.summary: India's milk production is projected to grow 2% to 226.5 million tonnes in 2027, slower than 2.5% in 2026, the USDA's New Delhi office said. El Nino-linked drought is expected to limit feed and fodder and hurt animal productivity.

stories.title: Dharwad seeks drought relief after crop loss on 2.88 lakh hectares
stories.summary: Dharwad's district administration asked the Karnataka government for drought relief after a joint survey found crop damage across 2,88,077 hectares in eight drought-hit taluks, Deputy Commissioner Snehal R said. Horticulture losses covered about 16,660 hectares. Farmers are asked to check their survey entries.

stories.title: Rayalaseema sweet lime orchards dry up as borewells fail
stories.summary: Sweet lime farmers in Andhra Pradesh's Rayalaseema region are watching orchards wither as borewells run dry after a prolonged rainfall deficit. Many are spending thousands of rupees on water tankers and say they need government relief.

stories.title: Nuh farmers rent out fields for burning industrial waste
stories.summary: Landowners in Haryana's Nuh district are renting fields to waste traders who truck in industrial refuse from Bhiwadi, Gurugram, Rewari and Alwar and set it alight, The Tribune reports. For some, garbage now pays better than onion or wheat.

stories.title: Karnataka CM seeks higher sugar MSP from the Centre
stories.summary: Chief Minister DK Shivakumar wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi seeking a revision of the minimum selling price of sugar and an order on ethanol production. Sugar mills have agreed to pass any increase on to protesting cane farmers.

stories.title: Karnataka shuts seven packaged drinking water units
stories.summary: Karnataka's Food Safety and Drug Administration closed seven packaged drinking water units for major violations including unhygienic conditions, operating without mandatory licences and refusing to cooperate with inspectors, as part of a statewide inspection drive.

stories.title: Kerala to survey leased forest land at Athirappilly over elephant corridor
stories.summary: The Forest Department and Plantation Corporation Kerala will jointly survey forest land leased for a resort at Athirappilly. There are disputes over lease violations, an obstructed elephant corridor and human-wildlife conflict around the project.

stories.title: India's exotic pet trade is growing faster than the rules
stories.summary: A Humane World for Animals report valued India's exotic pet market at $42.6 million in 2024 and expects it to nearly double by 2030, Mongabay India reports. Legal loopholes and weak enforcement make the trade hard to police.

stories.title: IMD tracks a new low-pressure system over the Andaman Sea
stories.summary: The IMD said a low-pressure area over the south Andaman Sea is likely to intensify into a depression by October 31. Remnants of Cyclone Arnab are still moving inland after weakening.

stories.title: The scientist behind Delhi's 72-hour pollution warnings
stories.summary: IITM Pune scientist Dr Sachin Ghude helped build India's air quality early warning system, which lets Delhi forecast severe pollution episodes up to 72 hours ahead so officials can act before the smog arrives, The Better India reports.

stories.title: Binance tries to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
stories.summary: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, said $6.3bn was taken in a 'complex' hack believed to be the largest of its kind, with North Korea linked to the attack. The firm says about $3bn has been frozen, and the rest is still out there.

stories.title: G20 drops its group photo as Europeans refuse to stand with Lavrov
stories.summary: The US scrapped the traditional G20 foreign ministers' photo in Atlanta after European officials refused to be pictured beside sanctioned Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov. The talks are also split over the Iran war, Hormuz disruption and Ukraine.

stories.title: Canada and the EU launch an Alliance for the Future
stories.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen unveiled a new alliance in Montreal that other like-minded countries can join. They described it as a protective canopy for citizens in a world 'shaken by new storms'.

stories.title: Carney expects a June deal making Canada the EU's first associate member
stories.summary: Carney said he expects talks with the EU to conclude in June on a partnership that stops short of full membership. It would be the closest relationship the bloc has ever had with an outside country.

stories.title: Pope Leo becomes the first pontiff to vote in a US election
stories.summary: The Vatican confirmed that the American-born Pope Leo XIV submitted a mail-in ballot in his native Chicago ahead of next week's midterm elections. It cited his longstanding belief in civic participation.

stories.title: US midterm early voting hits a record 47.9 million
stories.summary: A record 47.9 million Americans have already voted in the midterms, beating the 2022 early vote total of 45.9 million. Turnout is strongest in battleground states including Texas, North Carolina and Georgia.

stories.title: Appeals court again rejects Trump administration bid to set aside California ballots
stories.summary: For the second time in less than a week, the 9th Circuit rejected a petition from the Trump administration to remove 20,000 ballots from California's count. The court called the request unconstitutional.

stories.title: Trump says the Iran war will 'end soon' as Qatar pushes for a deal
stories.summary: President Trump said the war with Iran is 'going to end soon' without saying how. Qatari mediators returned to Tehran to push a peace deal between Iran and the US, while CENTCOM's chief repeated that Iran's navy has been destroyed.

stories.title: Oman rescues 25 crew from a burning tanker in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Oman's maritime security centre evacuated 25 crew members from a burning crude oil tanker as ships keep being targeted in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran said it halted three tankers trying to use what it called unauthorised routes.

stories.title: Oil heads for a fourth straight monthly gain
stories.summary: Oil prices rose on Friday and were on track for a fourth monthly gain after a tanker attack highlighted supply risks. Traders are watching flows out of the Middle East and possible escalation by US and allied forces.

stories.title: Chevron and Exxon hit record highs on refining profits
stories.summary: Chevron and ExxonMobil reported soaring third-quarter profits as US refineries ran at full capacity to take advantage of high diesel prices. Attacks on refineries in Russia and the Middle East have pushed up global fuel prices.

stories.title: Hundreds evacuated from occupied Oleshky during rare ceasefire
stories.summary: Hundreds of residents were evacuated from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky during a humanitarian ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump, Russian and Ukrainian authorities said. Hundreds more are believed to have stayed despite the dangers.

stories.title: US approves $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
stories.summary: The US approved the sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine for $2.1 billion, funded by Canada, Germany, Norway and EU-backed loans. Zelensky had complained of waiting nearly a month for the supplies.

stories.title: Zelenskiy says he will go to Turkey for 'important' talks
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said he will hold important talks in Turkey as part of diplomatic efforts to end more than four and a half years of war with Russia. He said he hopes talks can move to agreed formats in November.

stories.title: Fed officials say rates will need to rise again
stories.summary: St Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said another rate hike will need to happen soon, and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan predicted at least two more quarter-point increases. Markets now have an early hint of what comes next.

stories.title: Polish president turns his plane around after top court chief is suspended
stories.summary: Polish President Karol Nawrocki turned back his flight to Senegal after police entered the premises of Poland's Constitutional Tribunal and its president, Bogdan Swieczkowski, was suspended. Police said they went in after objects were thrown at officers outside the court.

stories.title: Brazil summons Argentine diplomat over Flavio Bolsonaro's flight to the US
stories.summary: Brazil called in Argentina's top diplomat in Brasilia to explain Argentina's role in Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's departure to the US after losing the presidential election, two Brazilian officials said. Argentina denied any summoning took place.

stories.title: Rebeca Grynspan extends her lead in the race for UN secretary-general
stories.summary: An informal Security Council poll showed former Costa Rican Vice President Rebeca Grynspan extending her lead as frontrunner to become the 10th UN secretary-general, two people close to the process said.

stories.title: Uganda asks the African Union to deploy a force against Ebola
stories.summary: Uganda asked the AU to consider deploying its standby force to help contain the Ebola outbreak, which has killed nearly 5,000 people in DR Congo and infected more than 10,000. Health officials from 45 African countries met to coordinate a response.

stories.title: Spain's transport minister refuses to resign after second deadly train crash
stories.summary: Spain's transport minister Oscar Puente rejected calls to quit after Wednesday's crash that killed at least 69 people, the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies. Lawmakers criticised him for blaming control centre operators, and unions want him dismissed.

stories.title: Algerian troops arrive in Niger in a rare foreign deployment
stories.summary: An Algerian army convoy arrived in Niger, Algeria's first foreign troop deployment since it sent forces to support Egypt in the 1973 war. Niger, like its Sahel neighbours, is fighting jihadist groups.

stories.title: Mass protests sweep Italy during a national strike
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of students and workers marched across Italy during a 24-hour general strike called by the union USB, demanding higher wages and better public services. They also protested the cost of living and increased military spending. Most protests were peaceful.

stories.title: French economy unexpectedly shrank last quarter
stories.summary: France's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter, adding to concerns about rising debt and a large budget deficit ahead of divisive presidential elections in April, Semafor reports. Polls suggest the far right and far left are leading, raising fears of contagion across the EU.

stories.title: Brazil's debt picture is its worst in a decade by some measures
stories.summary: New figures show Brazil's debt climbed through Lula's third term and the deficit hit a recent record high. His re-election had already sent markets tumbling on fears the fiscal picture will worsen.

stories.title: UN says over 300,000 remain displaced in Lebanon
stories.summary: More than 300,000 people displaced since early March remain internally displaced in Lebanon, the UN aid office said. UN rights chief Volker Türk also said he was deeply concerned about the closure of Russia's Novaya Gazeta.

stories.title: US I bonds will pay 5.51% for the next six months
stories.summary: The US Treasury said newly bought Series I bonds will pay 5.51% from November 1 to April 30, up from 4.26%. The fixed portion rises to 1.40%, the highest since 2006, with 4.08% tied to inflation.

stories.title: Canada ends avalanche dog rescues in the Rockies
stories.summary: Canada axed a 55-year-old search and rescue dog programme in its Rocky Mountain parks as part of budget cuts. The dogs have found missing hikers and children in places like Banff, and the decision has drawn outrage.

stories.title: Halloween costs more as cocoa and sugar prices rise
stories.summary: Americans are expected to spend a record $13.5 billion on Halloween, up from $13.1 billion, the National Retail Federation says. Higher cocoa and sugar prices are pushing candy inflation, which could pinch companies like Hershey.

stories.title: Intel closes down 28.58%, its worst day since the 1970s
stories.summary: Intel shares closed down 28.58% on Friday after weaker-than-expected guidance, the company's worst day since the 1970s, CNBC reported. The fall wiped about $12 billion off the US government's stake in the chipmaker.

stories.title: US tech stocks fall again as AI spending nears $1 trillion
stories.summary: Tech stocks dropped for a second day on worries about the hundreds of billions being spent on AI. The Nasdaq opened at its lowest in more than two months, and Alphabet fell another 1.4% after a 12% plunge on Thursday.

stories.title: Reddit has its worst day as a public company
stories.summary: Reddit shares closed down 29.27% on Friday after the company forecast weak fourth-quarter revenue, CNBC reported. It was the steepest one-day fall for the stock since Reddit listed on the New York Stock Exchange in March 2024, wiping out a large chunk of its market value.

stories.title: Big Tech's AI spending commitments top $3 trillion
stories.summary: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle have more than $3 trillion in combined AI spending commitments over the coming years, Bloomberg reported, including $1 trillion from Alphabet and $800 billion from Meta.

stories.title: Big Tech returns the least cash to shareholders in 15 years
stories.summary: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned just 9.3% of cash to shareholders in the first three quarters of 2026, a 15-year low, Reuters reported. The money is going into AI instead.

stories.title: CXMT swings to an $8.17 billion quarterly profit on memory prices
stories.summary: Chinese memory maker CXMT reported third-quarter revenue of about $16.7 billion, up 613.2% from a year earlier, and a net profit of about $8.17 billion, Reuters reported. Rising AI-driven memory chip prices did most of the work.

stories.title: Kioxia profit rises 22-fold but its outlook disappoints
stories.summary: NAND maker Kioxia reported a quarterly operating profit of about $12.7 billion, up 22 times from a year earlier and in line with estimates, Bloomberg reported. It forecast about the same for the next quarter, below the roughly $14.9 billion analysts expected.

stories.title: Sam Altman says RAM is better off in data centres than on your desk
stories.summary: Asked about the ongoing RAM shortage on the Cheeky Pint podcast, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said it is 'terrible' to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centres. PC buyers paying shortage prices may see it differently.

stories.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back a single opt-out from AI scraping
stories.summary: The four companies say they will adopt a new standard that lets publishers set AI training preferences once, across multiple AI firms, instead of repeating the request company by company, The Verge reports. Publishers have been asking for something like this for a while.

stories.title: Malicious Claude Code extension sat in Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours
stories.summary: A tainted Anthropic Claude Code extension was live in Cursor's extension marketplace for about 11 hours and was downloaded by 'at most 5,000 users', Wired reports. Flawed code in the malware stopped the attacker from fully taking over some machines.

stories.title: Anthropic renames its Claude Max plans and lifts a usage limit
stories.summary: Anthropic renamed its $100 a month Max 5x plan to Max and its $200 a month Max 20x plan to Ultra. It also removed the five-hour usage limit for verified Ultra accounts.

stories.title: Google says its Suncatcher data centre satellite is online
stories.summary: Google said its Suncatcher prototype data centre satellite, launched on October 1, is now online, TechCrunch reported. For its first task in orbit, its Gemma 4 model wrote a haiku about being in space. Space poetry now has a compute budget.

stories.title: Salesforce buys military logistics AI startup Rune
stories.summary: Salesforce acquired Rune, which makes AI software for military logistics, for $375 million in cash and stock, sources told Resilience Media. Rune had raised $30 million from a16z and others.

stories.title: AI law firm Crosby bids for assets of collapsing Weil Gotshal
stories.summary: Two-year-old AI-first law firm Crosby has bid to buy some of the assets of Weil, Gotshal and Manges, the Wall Street firm whose collapse has been the talk of the legal industry this week, TechCrunch reports.

stories.title: Meta settles another social media addiction case before trial
stories.summary: Meta reached a settlement in a social media addiction lawsuit brought by an 18-year-old woman from Mississippi, avoiding a trial set for next month. Snap is now the only defendant left in the case.

stories.title: UK court dismisses Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom requests
stories.summary: London's High Court rejected a challenge by Meta, TikTok and X to Ofcom's information requests under the Online Safety Act, dismissing their argument that the requests were disproportionate, Reuters reported.

stories.title: UK competition regulator opens probe into Meta's AI content terms
stories.summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority opened an investigation into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers, letting it use their content to develop its AI and other services, Reuters reported. Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, which together reach billions of users.

stories.title: US senators probe 'serious privacy risks' in Meta's AI glasses
stories.summary: Senators Ron Wyden and Edward Markey wrote to Mark Zuckerberg about Meta's smart glasses, saying they have 'increasingly been implicated in disturbing invasions of users' and bystanders' privacy'. They want Meta to explain its safeguards.

stories.title: House Democrats press OpenAI over firing of safety researchers
stories.summary: A group of 20 House Democrats asked OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to explain the dismissal of three safety researchers. They asked whether the firings could discourage employees from raising concerns about AI risks, and also raised security incidents.

stories.title: DOJ says 'ghost students' used AI to steal millions in student loans
stories.summary: The US charged five people in its first broad crackdown on fraudsters who steal identities to pose as college students and take student loans, partly using AI. The DOJ seized more than $750,000 in cryptocurrency from a linked network.

stories.title: Dartmouth provost resigns over undisclosed AI use
stories.summary: Dartmouth provost Santiago Schnell, who wrote an August op-ed about AI cheating at universities, resigned after a committee found he failed to disclose significant AI use in an academic paper and in that same op-ed, Ars Technica reports.

stories.title: Proton's CEO cancels AI 're-interviews' for staff
stories.summary: Proton CEO Andy Yen cancelled nearly company-wide 're-interviews' that would have required employees to explain how they use AI, six current employees told 404 Media. The move followed 404 Media's investigation into his AI push.

stories.title: Musk and Zuckerberg adopt Trump's 'super intelligence' term on earnings calls
stories.summary: A month after President Trump ordered federal agencies to say 'super intelligence' instead of artificial intelligence, Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg used the term on their earnings calls, CNBC reports. Most other tech CEOs stuck with AI.

stories.title: Pope Leo calls for AI to be 'disarmed'
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV said AI systems should be disarmed and that 'machines are tools, not persons'. He urged UN member states meeting in Geneva next month to take concrete steps toward banning lethal autonomous weapons.

stories.title: Wikimedia weighs in on the NYT copyright case against OpenAI
stories.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation filed an amicus brief in The New York Times' lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft. It argues that an extreme ruling in either direction could threaten the open web.

stories.title: Hardly anyone uses outside AI agents to order on DoorDash
stories.summary: DoorDash said on its earnings call that outside AI agents have so far led to only hundreds of orders, Ars Technica reports. It is still early days for agent shopping, which is one way to put it.

stories.title: Waymo and Toyota to test robotaxis in Japan in 2027
stories.summary: Waymo and Toyota will start testing a fleet of autonomous Toyota bZ4X electric vehicles in Japan in 2027. They plan to expand to other right-hand drive markets such as the UK afterwards.

stories.title: AI boom creates six-figure jobs for data centre community liaisons
stories.summary: Hyperscalers, AI labs and data centre developers are advertising six-figure roles for people who can win over communities where data centres are planned, a Semafor analysis found. Microsoft is among those hiring for community relations.

stories.title: UN nature summit adopts key texts in overtime
stories.summary: Nearly 200 nations adopted agreements at the COP17 biodiversity summit in Yerevan after two weeks of tense talks, aiming to get the 2030 goal of halting nature loss back on track. Gaps remain on finance, with the UN saying another $700 billion a year is needed.

stories.title: BP profits hit an 18-year high on Iran war refining margins
stories.summary: BP's underlying replacement cost profit nearly quadrupled to $8.46bn in the third quarter as the Middle East war pushed up oil and gas prices. BP called it a 'banner quarter'. Climate campaigners called it 'obscene'.

stories.title: Wildlife trade involves twice as many species as thought
stories.summary: More than 100,000 plant and animal species are traded globally, more than double earlier estimates, a study in Science Advances found. Trade spans illegal smuggling, ornaments, fisheries, timber and fashion, and the researchers say global assessments have big gaps.

stories.title: Human-driven warming may have halted the start of a new ice age
stories.summary: A study in Science tracking the Barnes ice cap on Canada's Baffin Island found that warming from burning fossil fuels reversed its expansion, which began about 2,000 years ago and signalled the onset of a new ice age.

stories.title: Meta signs a deal to help build a low-carbon cement plant in Missouri
stories.summary: Meta will buy environmental certificates from Fortera, which is working to build its first commercial low-carbon cement plant in Missouri. Tech companies want cleaner building materials for data centres, though very little clean cement exists yet.

stories.title: Trump administration is propping up nearly half of US coal plants
stories.summary: Federal support now reaches nearly half of all grid-connected US coal plants through taxpayer payments, pollution rule exemptions and orders to keep running past retirement dates, an Environmental Defense Fund analysis found.

stories.title: Lula to attend COP31 climate summit in Turkey
stories.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, re-elected last Sunday, will attend the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, the Brazilian presidency said. He arrives on November 10 for the leaders' summit and will hand the COP presidency to Turkey.

stories.title: COP31 presidency launches an Antalya AI pledge
stories.summary: Turkey's COP31 presidency introduced the Antalya Artificial Intelligence Pledge, which treats AI as a possible tool against climate change while flagging the growing energy and water use of AI itself.

stories.title: UK budget cuts put green heating targets at risk
stories.summary: Experts say Britain is unlikely to hit its green heating targets after more than £3bn of cuts to the energy department's budget, much of it moved to defence spending. Critics say former energy secretary Ed Miliband's agenda is being dismantled.

stories.title: Volkswagen pauses the electric Golf as losses mount
stories.summary: Volkswagen has suspended development of the Golf EV after reporting its largest quarterly loss since the 2015 Dieselgate scandal. CFO Arno Antlitz said the company 'must act quickly and decisively'.

stories.title: Harley-Davidson's LiveWire warns it may not survive
stories.summary: Electric motorcycle maker LiveWire said there is substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and withdrew its full-year guidance. Its stock fell more than 40% on the news.

stories.title: First Solar cuts its sales forecast over tariff uncertainty
stories.summary: First Solar reported third-quarter net sales of $1.23 billion, down 23%, and net income of $571 million. It lowered its sales forecast as customer uncertainty over Section 232 tariffs slowed orders.

stories.title: SEG Solar plans a $950 million cell factory near Houston
stories.summary: SEG Solar secured land for a 4 GW heterojunction solar cell plant at Tomball near Houston. The $950 million project is expected to create more than 700 jobs and come online in two phases in 2028 and 2029.

stories.title: Philippines stops US e-waste imports but free zones remain a gap
stories.summary: The Philippines has stopped accepting electronic waste from the US after months of activist pressure over shipments entering through the Subic Bay freeport. Policing customs-free zones remains a struggle, Mongabay reports.

stories.title: Strange permafrost landslides are spreading across the far north
stories.summary: Scientists are tracking a new kind of landslide, the 'permafrost detachment slide', as thawing frozen ground fails across the Arctic. One in Canada's Northwest Territories was big enough to block a river and create a lake, Grist reports.

stories.title: Angola protects Serra do Pingano after heavy forest loss
stories.summary: Angola declared Serra do Pingano a protected area after the central part of the northern region lost 43% of its forest over two decades. The wider forest ecosystem lost 21%, or 536 square kilometres.

stories.title: Attenborough-backed appeal buys a 9,500-acre Northumberland estate
stories.summary: The Wildlife Trusts and Northumberland Wildlife Trust completed the purchase of the Rothbury Estate after a two-year, £30m public appeal backed by Sir David Attenborough. They plan to restore its upland habitats.

stories.title: Nepal tests artificial scent marks to keep big cats away from villages
stories.summary: Researchers from Cornell, WWF Nepal and local forest authorities are testing lab-made versions of big-cat scent chemicals, called BioBoundaries, along Nepal's Khata Corridor. The idea, first tried in Botswana, is to steer tigers away from people.

stories.title: Crocodiles and Aztec methods help restore mangroves in Mexico
stories.summary: A nonprofit in Veracruz is reintroducing Morelet's crocodiles and planting mangroves on raised mounds called chinampas, an Aztec technique, to restore the Alvarado Lagoons System, Mongabay reports. Supporters say crocodiles keep channels open, though some researchers say evidence is thin.

stories.title: Botswana's San move closer to secure land rights
stories.summary: Nearly 20 years after winning a landmark case against their removal from the Central Kalahari Game Reserve, Indigenous San communities may soon secure broader legal rights to their ancestral land through a restitution process, Mongabay reports.

stories.title: Benin secures €30 million for its first private solar plants
stories.summary: Axian signed €30 million of financing from the IFC and Proparco for four solar plants totalling 62 MW. They form IPP50, Benin's first independent power producer solar project, with IFC also drawing on the Clean Technology Fund.

stories.title: Western Australia moves to legalise plug-in balcony solar
stories.summary: Western Australia has started consultation on a technical standard and path to legalise plug-in solar panels and batteries, which would let renters get cheaper power without owning the roof. Plugging a generator into a household socket is not yet allowed.

stories.title: Researchers map the main costs of solar panel recycling
stories.summary: Researchers at Brazil's PUCPR proposed a framework to assess the costs of recycling end-of-life solar panels in emerging economies. Experts ranked operations and production as the biggest cost factor, followed closely by infrastructure and facilities.

stories.title: Diet and exercise put type 2 diabetes into remission for 54% of younger adults
stories.summary: In a trial presented at the EASD meeting, 54% of adults under 45 with type 2 diabetes who followed a low-calorie diet with structured exercise reached remission within six months, against 4% on usual care. Remission is not a cure, and needs ongoing support.

stories.title: Sleeping 6.4 to 7.8 hours linked to slower biological ageing
stories.summary: A Nature study drawing on data from about half a million adults found people who sleep 6.4 to 7.8 hours a night tend to show the slowest biological ageing. Shorter and longer sleep were both linked to faster ageing. The link is an association, not proof.

stories.title: WHO Europe adopts plans on healthy ageing and AI in health
stories.summary: The 53 member states of the WHO European Region adopted a healthy ageing strategy and a roadmap on AI in health in Copenhagen. WHO says people are living longer but not always in good health, and AI is arriving faster than its rules.

stories.title: WHO says housing is a health issue on World Cities Day
stories.summary: WHO called for safe, healthy housing for all, citing UN-Habitat figures that up to 3.4 billion people lack secure, adequate housing, including more than 1 billion in informal settlements. Where people live shapes how long and how well they live, it said.

stories.title: Retatrutide eased sleep apnea in two late-stage trials
stories.summary: The experimental drug retatrutide greatly reduced obstructive sleep apnea symptoms in two phase 3 trials in people with overweight or obesity. Sleep apnea raises the risk of heart disease and dementia, and is often undiagnosed. The drug is not yet approved.

stories.title: Vegans had lower gut bacterial diversity than meat eaters in a Danish study
stories.summary: University of Copenhagen researchers compared the gut microbiomes of 75 vegans and 75 omnivores and, to their surprise, found lower average bacterial diversity among vegans. They had expected a fibre-rich plant diet to come out ahead on every measure.

stories.title: Doctors urge caution as US eases access to six peptides
stories.summary: HHS Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr allowed six previously illegal peptides to be made and prescribed, a move that bypassed FDA scientists' objections. Longevity doctors told Oprah Daily the hype is moving faster than the evidence on benefits, safety and dosing.

stories.title: Election stress can affect the heart, studies suggest
stories.summary: Ahead of Tuesday's US midterms, health researchers point to studies linking divisive elections to a higher chance of irregular heartbeats in the weeks around voting and more heart attack hospitalisations right after, STAT reports.

stories.title: Patients billed ER prices for urgent care at hybrid clinics
stories.summary: A STAT investigation found patients at Intuitive Health's roughly 50 hybrid ER and urgent care clinics came in with simple problems but were billed for emergency care, including close to $2,000 for a UTI. The company says patients should sign a form first.

stories.title: Lancet report says the manosphere is a public health risk
stories.summary: A Lancet report says the manosphere, online communities that often blame women and feminism for men's struggles, is fuelling harmful attitudes and worsening health inequalities among boys and men. It calls for social and economic policies addressing why these groups appeal.

stories.title: Researchers propose circadian depression as a possible subtype
stories.summary: Australian researchers writing in the British Journal of Psychiatry suggest a disrupted body clock may be a core feature of depression for some people, with late nights, long sleep and exhaustion. That raises the question of whether body clock treatments could help.

stories.title: One in five tribal mothers in Odisha's PVTGs still give birth at home
stories.summary: Institutional deliveries among Odisha's Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups have risen to nearly 78%, a new study found, but at least one in five women still give birth at home. Poor transport, difficult terrain and social barriers keep many from health facilities.

stories.title: Kerala awaits expert report on expired Remdesivir given to Nipah patients
stories.summary: Health Minister K Muraleedharan said action on allegations that expired Remdesivir was given to Nipah patients at Kozhikode Medical College will follow an expert panel's report. Stock bought in 2021 with a May 2023 expiry may have been used until 2025.

stories.title: Bangladesh plans nearly 1 lakh new health worker posts
stories.summary: Bangladesh's government plans to create nearly 1 lakh field health worker posts over three years, bringing three categories of community caregivers under one unified system to expand grassroots care, The Daily Star reports.

stories.title: Nicotine exposure before birth worsened flu later in life in mice
stories.summary: A UC Santa Cruz study in mice found nicotine exposure during pregnancy and just after birth altered blood-forming stem cells and lung immune cells, leading to more severe flu later. The work, in Stem Cell Reports, focused on nicotine alone.

stories.title: What running a marathon does to your heart
stories.summary: Cardiac arrests at US long-distance races are rare, with 176 recorded among about 29 million finishers in one study. Experts told TIME regular exercise is clearly good for the heart, and explained how runners can train sensibly and stay safe.

stories.title: Short bursts of squats may build strength like one longer session
stories.summary: A study found splitting 60 weighted squats into three one-minute sessions across the day built strength almost as well as doing them all at once, a handy option for people short on time.

stories.title: Louisiana warns against using tap water for nasal rinses and contact lenses
stories.summary: The Louisiana Department of Health warned residents not to use tap water to rinse nasal passages or clean contact lenses after rare amoeba infections. The state has recorded ten such infections since 2024. Officials say the right water and good lens hygiene cut the risk.

stories.title: Victoria warns of thunderstorm asthma risk
stories.summary: Victoria's Chief Health Officer Caroline McElnay warned of heightened thunderstorm asthma conditions across eastern and northern parts of the state. She urged people to act on symptoms like wheezing, breathlessness or a persistent cough.

stories.title: Dutch campaign warns about health risks of burning wood
stories.summary: A new Dutch public campaign warns that smoke from wood-burning stoves can harm health and bother neighbours, as more households may turn to wood heating this winter. The cosy smell, it turns out, is part of the problem.

stories.title: Health experts oppose permanent daylight saving time
stories.summary: As US clocks go back an hour on Sunday, a new study warns that year-round daylight saving time would mean millions more children commuting to school in the dark, with a greater risk of deadly crashes, NBC News reports.

stories.title: Lower fitness linked to persistent fatty liver in teen boys with obesity
stories.summary: A Belgian study of 142 adolescents with severe obesity found boys whose fatty liver disease persisted through a lifestyle programme started with markedly lower fitness. The link was weaker in girls, researchers reported in JHEP Reports.

stories.title: ISRO's GSLV-F18 places NVS-03 in its intended orbit
stories.summary: ISRO's GSLV-F18 lifted off from Sriharikota on Friday night and placed the 2,250 kg NVS-03 navigation satellite into its intended geosynchronous transfer orbit about 18.46 minutes later, completing the agency's third launch of 2026.

stories.title: NavIC is back to four working satellites, says ISRO chief
stories.summary: With NVS-03 in orbit, India's NavIC regional navigation system is restored to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites, ISRO chief V Narayanan said. Three satellites, including NVS-01, were already working, and the new one makes the fourth.

stories.title: NASA asks industry how it could service Hubble
stories.summary: NASA issued a request for information on October 29 about commercial in-space servicing for the Hubble Space Telescope. Administrator Jared Isaacman said Hubble still has important science ahead and NASA should look at every reasonable way to keep it going.

stories.title: Voyager 1 is about to be one light-day from Earth
stories.summary: Next month NASA's Voyager 1 will reach about 16 billion miles from Earth, roughly one light-day, the farthest any spacecraft has travelled. It is heading toward the star Gliese 445, which it should pass in about 40,000 years.

stories.title: NASA's year-long Mars simulation crew comes home on October 31
stories.summary: NASA's second Crew Health and Performance Analog mission ends at Johnson Space Center on October 31, when the door of the 3D-printed habitat opens for four crew members after 378 days of simulated life on Mars.

stories.title: Space station crew wraps up crop research after spacewalk
stories.summary: After the first of two power upgrade spacewalks on the ISS, the Expedition 75 crew finished the week with space crop research plus studies involving virtual reality and AI, NASA said.

stories.title: ESA's October includes Hera's first asteroid images and Adenot's return
stories.summary: ESA's monthly roundup covers Hera's first images of the asteroids it will study, ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot's return after 237 days in space, Smile capturing a full ring of northern lights and Mars Express clues about a giant Martian cloud.

stories.title: Sentinel-3 captures the eye of Super Typhoon Champi
stories.summary: ESA's Earth from Space this week shows Super Typhoon Champi off Taiwan and the Philippines on October 21, captured by Copernicus Sentinel-3 in false colour. The storm's eye spans about 50 km.

stories.title: Hubble finds stellar winds may have blocked, not freed, early starlight
stories.summary: Hubble observations challenge a leading idea about how the universe cleared its hydrogen fog about 13 billion years ago. Winds from exploding stars were thought to help radiation escape galaxies, but the new data suggest they actually blocked it.

stories.title: Physicists build a tiny universe and watch time emerge without a clock
stories.summary: A University of Birmingham researcher used 24,000 ultracold atoms to build an isolated quantum system that expands and contracts like a Big Bang and Big Crunch. The experiment showed time can emerge from changes inside the system, with no external clock.

stories.title: Warm-loving habits may explain why crocodiles survived the dinosaur asteroid
stories.summary: A UCL-led analysis of fossils and ancient climates suggests crocodiles survived the asteroid impact 66 million years ago because their preference for warmth put them in tropical refuges that stayed habitable afterwards.

stories.title: IIT Gandhinagar scientist beats a network distance limit set in 1996
stories.summary: A computer scientist at IIT Gandhinagar developed an algorithm that gives more reliable distance estimates between closely connected points in huge networks without losing speed, overcoming a limitation that stood since 1996. It samples connections at multiple scales.

stories.title: Heaviest pumpkin ever becomes the heaviest jack o'lantern ever
stories.summary: The 3,156 lb record pumpkin grown by Ron Wallace was bought by Raising Cane's founder Todd Graves and carved in Salem, Massachusetts into the heaviest jack o'lantern of all time. Decorations included bats, a witch and crinkle-cut fries. Naturally.

stories.title: Delta pilot lets passengers vote on flying with the smell of dog
stories.summary: A dog relieved itself on a Delta plane during an earlier flight, so the pilot asked passengers whether they wanted the cabin cleaned or an on-time departure. A show of hands chose leaving on time, smell included.

stories.title: ZXMOTO founder rides a motorcycle 40.74 km across water
stories.summary: Zhang Xue, founder of ZXMOTO, rode a modified MX450 fitted with flotation gear 40.74 km across open water in Hunan, beating the previous Guinness mark of 31.8 km. It took several failed attempts. The river did not comment.

stories.title: 110 humanoid robots dance in sync for a Guinness record
stories.summary: Chinese robotics firm AGIBOT set the record for most humanoid robots dancing at once, with 110 standard Expedition A3 units jumping, switching formations and spelling out 2026 in Jinan. A Guinness adjudicator counted every one.

stories.title: Bugatti CEO leaves keys in his Chiron, Chiron leaves
stories.summary: Mate Rimac said he always left his keys in his cars because Croatia felt so safe. His Bugatti Chiron was then driven off from the factory. Austrian police caught the driver using the car's own data. Rimac says he has changed the habit.

stories.title: Pennsylvania retiree watches 1,207 films in cinemas in one year
stories.summary: A 60-year-old retiree spent a year at his local Regal cinema in York Haven, Pennsylvania, averaging 3.3 films a day to set a Guinness record of 1,207. The previous record was 777. He planned each day from the listings.

stories.title: Alnwick Poison Garden earns a record for its 97 deadly plants
stories.summary: Northumberland's Alnwick Poison Garden is now a Guinness record holder for the most species in a poison garden, with 97 toxic and narcotic plants. Visitors are not allowed to touch, taste or smell anything, which seems fair.

stories.title: Guinness notes that Poland dominates cold endurance records
stories.summary: Guinness World Records looked at its cold endurance titles and found them largely held by people from Poland, from long stints in icy water to standing buried in snow. A chilly winter at home may count as training.

stories.title: Kyrgyzstan plans what could be the world's longest glass bridge
stories.summary: Kyrgyzstan plans a 732 metre glass suspension bridge in Ala-Archa State Nature Park, with construction due to start in November 2026 and finish by end-2027. Officials are considering asking Guinness World Records to confirm it is the longest of its kind.

stories.title: Iraqi pharmacy sets a record for hydration pledges
stories.summary: Haya Pharmacy's Ghaith campaign in Iraq collected 79,069 pledges in one month from people promising to drink more water, earning a Guinness record for a hydration awareness campaign. The record was confirmed in Baghdad on October 5.

stories.title: A new app shows you which hours of your day the phone ate
stories.summary: The iOS app Oh My Hours splits each day into hour-long blocks and puts a black mark next to the ones lost to Instagram and TikTok. It is free to start, with a $10 a year upgrade for the full view of the damage.

stories.title: A squid from Wyoming, 160 million years late
stories.summary: Researchers named a new belemnite, Wyoteuthis linsterorum, which translates roughly as a squid from Wyoming. Its fossils came from rocks about 160 million years old, from a time when the state had an ocean instead of rodeos, Papers in Palaeontology reports.

research.title: Astronauts just gave the International Space Station a powerful upgrade
research.summary: Two astronauts completed a 7-hour, 11-minute spacewalk to install a new solar array on the International Space Station, bringing NASA one step closer to a major power upgrade. Once the final array is installed on November 5, the station will have up to 30% more available power, supporting.

research.title: Briefing Chat: Dog years: could longevity science extend your pets' lives?
research.summary: Nature, Published online: 30 October 2026, doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03553-7 Nature staff discuss the emerging field of pet longevity, plus, a researcher decides not to care about their student reviews. Are they wrong?

research.title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Hubble reveals a stunning twist in how the universe emerged from darkness
research.summary: A surprising discovery by astronomers using the Hubble Space Telescope is challenging a leading explanation for how the early universe emerged from a dense fog of hydrogen roughly 13 billion years ago. Scientists once believed powerful winds from exploding stars helped radiation escape galaxies and clear that cosmic.

research.title: I built the UK government’s metascience unit, here’s what countries need to know
research.summary: Nature, Published online: 30 October 2026, doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03502-4 To find evidence-backed ways to improve grant-funding processes, metascientists need freedom and money to experiment, as well as leaders who are willing to make change.

research.title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
